items.title: Mortgage Rates Back Under Pressure as Tech Stocks Bounce
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: The bond market is closed today for Veterans Day, but with tech stocks rallying, the pressure is back on mortgage rates. items.title: Hot CPI Report Sends Mortgage Rates Surging Higher
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: And just like that, mortgage rates are back under immense pressure thanks to a hotter-than-expected inflation report. As I pointed out yesterday, CPI was the big one to watch this week, and it didn’t go the way mortgage shoppers wanted. items.title: Goldman Sachs Sees Mortgage Rates Falling to 6.4% in 2027
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Goldman Sachs just put out their 2027 housing outlook and the good news is it has mortgage rates coming down next year. And by a healthy margin at that, with the popular 30-year fixed sliding to 6.4% at some point. items.title: Tech Selloff Keeps Pushing Mortgage Rates Closer to the 6s
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Mortgage rates are even lower today, inching their way closer and closer to a 6-handle. And once again tech stocks are getting hammered, pushing a lot of money toward the safety of bonds.
